name: Indra Putra Mahayuda
tagline: AI Engineer | Data Scientist | Computer Vision
about: AI Engineer and Data Scientist with 3+ years of experience in machine learning, computer vision, and system optimization across industries including mining, autonomous vehicle and humanoid robotic. Skilled in building end-to-end AI solutions, from data analysis and model development to deployment, bridging technology with real-world business needs.

projects.title: Football Analysis with Computer Vision
projects.description: Developed a computer vision system to analyze football match footage, extracting player positions, movements, and key events to provide tactical insights and performance metrics for teams and coaches.

projects.title: Advanced Driver System using Radar-Camera Fusion
projects.description: Developed an advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) utilizing radar-camera fusion to enhance vehicle perception capabilities, improving object detection accuracy and distance measurement for safer driving experiences.

projects.title: Object Detection and Localization for Humanoid Robots
projects.description: Developed a computer vision system for humanoid robots in the EEPIS Robot Soccer Competition, detecting the ball for interception and kicking, and landmarks for field position estimation. Achieved 1st place in 2021 and 3rd place in 2022.

projects.title: Automatic Indonesian License Plate Recognition for Parking System
projects.description: Developed an automatic license plate recognition system for parking management, improving efficiency and accuracy in vehicle identification and tracking.
